description: This file implements error handling functions for the Thunder project, including custom error code handling, error-to-string conversions, and related utilities within the Thunder::Core namespace.

methods.name: HandleCustomErrorCodeToString
methods.description: Converts a custom error code to a string message, handling special cases.

methods.name: HandleCustomErrorCodeToStringExtended
methods.description: Provides an extended string representation for custom error codes, including the code value.

methods.name: SetCustomCodeToStringHandler
methods.description: Sets the handler function for custom error code to string conversion.

methods.name: CustomCode
methods.description: Creates an hresult from a custom 24-bit error code, setting the custom error bit.

methods.name: IsCustomCode
methods.description: Extracts the custom error code from an hresult if it has the custom error bit set.

methods.name: ErrorToString
methods.description: Converts an hresult to a human-readable string, handling custom error codes.

methods.name: ErrorToStringExtended
methods.description: Provides an extended string representation of an hresult, including detailed error info.
